verdict.rationale: The evidence describes AI Gateway as a request-time proxy offering caching, rate limiting, fallbacks, dynamic routing, and logging. Nothing in the pack documents user-configurable automations, schedules, or background jobs that run autonomously. Automatic retries and fallbacks are per-request resilience behavior, an adjacent feature rather than background automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
